name: stub, placeholder, or no computed result
name_zh: stub, placeholder, or no computed result
definition: Body produces no meaningful task computation: pass/TODO, docstring-only, unused/missing return, constant placeholder, tautological predicate, commented draft, or truncation.
inclusion: pass/TODO; no return; constant 0/None/True; parameter never read; trimmed body.
exclusion: Real computation with wrong value; hardcoded lookup answering some inputs; identity transform.

name: missing return path or abandoned accumulator
name_zh: missing return path or abandoned accumulator
definition: Execution falls off the end, or an initialized result/counter/seed is never returned, or only a dead/partial branch returns, so required output is absent.
inclusion: Body ends without return; only false branch returns; initialized notes discarded; seed never collected.
exclusion: Explicit placeholder constant; wrong-shaped but returned value.

name: premature or first-match selection before full scan
name_zh: premature or first-match selection before full scan
definition: A terminal return/index fires on first or local hit where extremal, last-occurrence, full-scan, or tie-aware selection is required; later candidates never examined.
inclusion: return inside loop on local hit; sorted[1] for second smallest; branch returns x before testing larger y.
exclusion: Correct first-match by spec; single candidate tested once.

name: wrong task, substituted procedure, or spec read at wrong granularity
name_zh: wrong task, substituted procedure, or spec read at wrong granularity
definition: Coherent algorithm for a different task, substituted goal, or spec term read at wrong granularity/domain/composition, giving semantically unrelated output.
inclusion: Primality vs triple-prime; bit-sum for digit-sum; character startswith where word required; set cardinality for window distinctness.
exclusion: Correct shape with one wrong operator/constant; missing conjunct; placeholder.

name: required conjunct, predicate, filter, or transformation stage dropped
name_zh: required conjunct, predicate, filter, or transformation stage dropped
definition: Correct skeleton omits a required scope predicate/conjunct, guard, parity/domain filter, or processing/reconstruction stage, silently solving a simpler or raw problem.
inclusion: Sum without parity filter; dropped integer/positive guard; no sorted()/replace/sqrt; palindrome on raw s; frequency dict returned without max.
exclusion: Whole algorithm substituted; one branch operator wrong; output shape only.

name: wrong recursive structure, base, or termination
name_zh: wrong recursive structure, base, or termination
definition: Recursive/iterative definition models wrong ordering/nesting, or base value, termination test, argument shrinking, or call direction is wrong, producing wrong results or nontermination.
inclusion: Symmetric minima instead of alternating extremes; wrong empty termination; n+1 recursion; wrong-end shrink.
exclusion: No recurrence attempted; iterative substitute; missing single branch.

name: undefined name, phantom helper, or missing import
name_zh: undefined name, phantom helper, or missing import
definition: References a name/helper/module/data shape never defined or imported, or invents an API, guaranteeing NameError or fabricated-field failure independent of algorithm.
inclusion: Undefined is_prime/find_palindrome_prefix; set.count(); reduce without functools; fabricated planets dict; invented nested offsets.
exclusion: Resolved API with wrong semantics; helper defined elsewhere; unused local.

name: wrong tokenization, operand extraction, or unit of analysis
name_zh: wrong tokenization, operand extraction, or unit of analysis
definition: Parses with wrong delimiter/type/index, splits on wrong composite boundary, or treats surface tokens where semantic entities are defined, so the unit of analysis is wrong before computation.
inclusion: int() on word numbers; split('|') on spaces; literal ', ' failing bare commas; lexical sort of number words; '' join instead of ' '.
exclusion: Correct tokens with wrong output delimiter; correct parse with wrong relation.

name: presence vs multiplicity counting or wrong dedup rule
name_zh: presence vs multiplicity counting or wrong dedup rule
definition: Counts each item once where multiplicity matters, deduplicates by set where frequency-aware removal/singleton filtering required, or relies on non-overlapping str.count/set equality.
inclusion: x in y where per-char count needed; list(set(..)) as answer; str.count non-overlap; set equality for multiset.
exclusion: Distinct counting where distinct specified; correct frequency with off-by-one; delimiter errors.

name: wrong scan position, order, stride, direction, or index scope
name_zh: wrong scan position, order, stride, direction, or index scope
definition: Loop range, slice bound, start index, stride, or traversal direction is misaligned: first vs last, wrong span, overlapping skipped, positions not interleaved, or local window where prefix aggregate required.
inclusion: range(len(xs)-1) loses last; i+=len(sub) skips overlaps; evens-then-odds extend; window at index 1.
exclusion: Comparison strictness; missing modulo; correct scope wrong predicate.

name: wrong sort key, direction, extremum, or selection representation
name_zh: wrong sort key, direction, extremum, or selection representation
definition: Sorts/compares wrong collection, uses wrong key or fixed direction where condition-dependent, selects wrong extremum, or returns wrong representation of sorted data.
inclusion: sorted(s.split()) sorts words; unconditional ascending where parity decides; min where max needed; sorts converted digits.
exclusion: Correct sort with boundary bug; wrong membership/filter; off-by-one bounds.

name: wrong operator, formula, metric, or comparison operand in a branch
name_zh: wrong operator, formula, metric, or comparison operand in a branch
definition: Recognizable strategy mostly correct, but one branch operator/multiplier/formula or chosen quantity/operand is wrong, systematically breaking that case.
inclusion: Odd-branch squaring gives 2n-1; a==b+c instead of sum; divisor init 1; length vs summed lengths; x%3 vs i%3.
exclusion: Coherent different task; missing branch; comparison strictness only.

name: hardcoded cases, literal parameters, fixed/fallback result, or overfit to examples
name_zh: hardcoded cases, literal parameters, fixed/fallback result, or overfit to examples
definition: Branches on small input set, reassigns parameters to literals, returns fixed/degenerate value, or matches a doctest/sample rather than the general rule, masking defects.
inclusion: bases 2/8/16 with None fallback; lst=[0,3,2,1]; constant return matching False doctest; index-3 coincidence; nested hardcoded tables.
exclusion: General loop with edge-case miss; legitimate small vocabulary dict; whole-body stub.

name: missing or wrong boundary/edge guard or invented precondition
name_zh: missing or wrong boundary/edge guard or invented precondition
definition: Boundary input (empty, singleton, k==0, no letters, zero, a==b) lacks a branch/length guard causing crash or invalid result, or an unstated precondition rejects valid inputs.
inclusion: No n==3; no empty guard before txt[-1]; n=1 treated prime; year>=1900 gate; equal-length precondition.
exclusion: Guard present but operator wrong; quiet catch-all fallback; wrong core algorithm.

name: wrong constant domain, character set, or case handling
name_zh: wrong constant domain, character set, or case handling
definition: Lookup/filter mechanism sound but embedded constant set is incomplete/misdefined, or handles only one case where both required, so required characters/inputs mishandled.
inclusion: Vowel set 'aeiou' only; lowercase-only literals with uppercase doctest; wrong special member; A-Z shift only lowercase.
exclusion: Wrong algorithm shape; correct constant with wrong operand; wrong formula secondary to case gap.

name: boundary comparison off at equality or seed value
name_zh: boundary comparison off at equality or seed value
definition: Relational guard uses wrong comparison at equality, or exact half-way/inclusive/singleton/tie/seed rule implemented via truncation or one-directional fallback.
inclusion: >= vs > routing equality; int() truncation instead of rounding; strict x<y for singleton; fib4(1) returns 1 not 0.
exclusion: Wholly missing guard; missing modulo; loop-bound off-by-one.

name: missing modular, sign, or rotation normalization
name_zh: missing modular, sign, or rotation normalization
definition: Raw shift/offset/sign used without required modulo, wraparound, or sign normalization, or residue constants misplaced, so cyclic/alphabet-boundary/negative inputs come out wrong.
inclusion: Rotation lacks % len; ord('a') inside modulo; missing +26 before %; missing abs for negatives.
exclusion: Wrong rotation direction with correct arithmetic; wrong character set; missing cast.

name: missing secondary sort or tie-break rule
name_zh: missing secondary sort or tie-break rule
definition: Primary filtering/ordering correct, but specified secondary ordering (alphabetical among equal lengths) or index tie-break omitted; stable sort masks the omission.
inclusion: key=len only where alphabetical tie-break required; no comparator; ties depend on input order.
exclusion: Primary-order errors; reversed primary direction; absent whole sort.

name: violated stated constraint, efficiency rule, or unfaithful validation
name_zh: violated stated constraint, efficiency rule, or unfaithful validation
definition: Violates explicit non-functional constraint/efficiency requirement, or validates format with unanchored/wrong-class pattern or missing length/count check, accepting malformed or rejecting valid input.
inclusion: Self-recursion despite ban; exponential without memo; re.match without ^/$; no len(date)==10; no count before unpack.
exclusion: Correct iterative solution; intentional fixed-domain table; over-strict invented precondition.

name: container/API contract runtime failure or ignored parameter
name_zh: container/API contract runtime failure or ignored parameter
definition: Assumes a container/API contract that fails at runtime (mask on list, most_common on array, sort on tuple, int on empty), or a capacity/state parameter is unused, shadowed, or rebound.
inclusion: Boolean list as index; most_common on array; interval1.sort() on tuple; capacity never checked; comprehension shadows n; lambda param shadows target.
exclusion: Undefined names; parameter used with wrong formula; harmless misleading names.

name: inverted, tautological, or wrong-polarity condition
name_zh: inverted, tautological, or wrong-polarity condition
definition: Condition flipped, always true/false, imposes no constraint, tests complement/inverse of specified relation, or routes branches wrongly, yielding anti-correct behaviour.
inclusion: Variable compared to itself; always-true modulo; identical if/else arms; x is y instead of x==y+z; i%3!=0; missing else.
exclusion: Wrong threshold same side; missing condition entirely; wrong aggregate.

name: type, conversion, or representational level confusion
name_zh: type, conversion, or representational level confusion
definition: Operands/types/levels conflated or required casts omitted: strings used as numbers/chars, list vs scalar arithmetic, multi-char strings treated as single chars, numeric strings not normalized.
inclusion: str with ^; missing int()/str(); recurrence over lists; '+' concatenation vs numeric; '-' in str int; char % 2.
exclusion: Correct conversion with wrong API semantics; wrong metric alone; correct level wrong range.

name: wrong return format, shape, or destructive input mutation
name_zh: wrong return format, shape, or destructive input mutation
definition: Value computed but returned in wrong type/length/tuple packing/delimiter/scale, or function mutates/normalizes input destructively, losing order, case, sign, or multiplicity later needed.
inclusion: List where int; swapped tuple slots; bin()[2:] drops '0b'; list.sort() on parameter; lower() before case swap; set() drops duplicates; abs() discards sign.
exclusion: Missing return (falls off); wrong-valued but correctly shaped; mutation explicitly allowed.

name: missing word/neighbor boundary or single regex cannot express contract
name_zh: missing word/neighbor boundary or single regex cannot express contract
definition: Tests a single element where relation to neighbor/delimiter required (bare startswith, last char alone), or chosen control structure/single regex cannot represent per-side, tiered, nested conditions.
inclusion: startswith('I') without space; only last char isalpha; never inspects neighbor; one regex for nesting depth; if/elif forcing single side.
exclusion: Neighbor tested with wrong operator/direction; missing conjunct; correct regex for regular sub-property.

name: under-specified equality, wrong predicate rule, or one-sided predicate
name_zh: under-specified equality, wrong predicate rule, or one-sided predicate
definition: Tests weaker pairwise/per-item property instead of exact equality/global uniformity, or uses wrong parity/digit/bound predicate, so mixed or one-sided cases wrongly accepted/counted.
inclusion: All-three-equal vs pairwise distinct; startswith vs exact 'I'; isalpha and not isalnum; count non-zero digits where odd required; both endpoints where only upper bound.
exclusion: Missing neighborhood context; omitted conjunct; crash from empty indexing.

name: incomplete permutation/rotation coverage or unnormalized comparison
name_zh: incomplete permutation/rotation coverage or unnormalized comparison
definition: Checks only truncated subset of symmetric orientations (one rotation, one hypotenuse assignment, reversed args) or compares unnormalized operands, so other orientations or numeric-string inputs fail.
inclusion: Hardcoded one-of-N ordering; missing permutation loop; a>b on comma-separated numeric strings.
exclusion: Full permutations with wrong predicate; pure off-by-one; missing conjunct.

name: docstring example or spec contradicts code
name_zh: docstring example or spec contradicts code
definition: Retained doctest/example or docstring is inconsistent with what code returns or raises, or spec internally inconsistent, showing examples not reconciled with implementation.
inclusion: Code yields 24 where doctest says 288; stub with numeric-root doctest; non-negative claim with negative example.
exclusion: Examples consistent but code overfits to them; examples absent; cosmetic scaffold.

name: no verifiable defect or implementation is correct
name_zh: no verifiable defect or implementation is correct
definition: The incorrect implementation cannot be shown to be defective from the supplied material: it matches the ground truth in behaviour, the task itself is contradictory or under-specified, or the difference is only stylistic. Used only after comparing task, implementation and ground truth.
inclusion: Behaviourally equivalent code; only cosmetic/comment differences; task statement contradicts its own examples so no implementation can satisfy it; defect cannot be attributed without execution that the material does not permit.
exclusion: Any concrete wrong value, crash, missing step or violated constraint, even if it also differs cosmetically. Do not use merely because the mechanism is hard to name.
